caption:
Two empty naloxone kits don't look like much. But they may mean someone used them to reverse an overdose, and someone got to go home. 💛

We found these on Barton today, cases open and instructions scattered in the mulch. We cleaned them up, but the message on those cards is worth sharing:

🩹 Naloxone kits are free at participating pharmacies, no prescription needed.
🚨 See an overdose? Call 911 first.
🛡️ Canada's Good Samaritan Drug Overdose Act protects people who call for help.

Carry a kit. Learn the 5 steps. You never know whose day you'll save.
